title: 第9章 巧了我也是万魂殿的第10章 女子无事莫出门
slug: 什么梦中的娘子都是真的
content_zh:
叶羽猛然回头看去。
只见一位长相绝美的女子。
脚踏飞剑，凌于空中。
叶羽顿时眼皮狂跳。
御剑飞行，乃是筑基境巅峰，乃至金丹境才能够做到的事情。
这可怎么办？
原本叶羽打算将侯旺、侯震两兄弟干掉，再从山下扔出去。
神不知鬼不觉。
可现在，被人看的清清楚楚。
这可真的是百口莫辩了。
御剑的女子见叶羽一直没有开口说话。
当即沉声道：“我乃青云宗执法堂卫傲舒。
现在回答我，你刚刚用的功法，到底是什么？”
叶羽紧握双拳。
依旧沉默不语。
因为他真的不知道该如何解释才好。
摄人魂魄。
绝对是魔门功法。
跟青云宗半点边都不沾。
而且，就算抛开功法不说。

击杀内门弟子本就是死罪。
被执法堂弟子遇上后，可就地正法。
不管怎么说，都是个死。
混蛋，才不过刚刚得到系统就这么点背吗？
若是能够再给自己几天发育时间就好了。
叶羽思索再三后。
正当考虑要不要殊死一搏之时。
卫傲舒突然笑了起来。
跳下飞剑。
来到叶羽的面前。
低声说道：“万魂殿！”
听到这三个字。
叶羽猛然睁大了双眼。
这个女人怎么知道万魂殿？
难不成，梦境中的万魂殿，在这里也真的存在？
“你刚刚所使用的，是万魂殿内的拘魂术吧？
我也是万魂殿的人。
遇见我，真是你的幸运。”
卫傲舒微微挑眉。
content_en:
Ye Yu suddenly looked back.
I saw a very beautiful woman.
He stepped on the flying sword and flew in the air.
Ye Yu's eyelids suddenly jumped wildly.
Flying with a sword is something that only the peak of the Foundation Establishment Realm and even the Golden Core Realm can do.
What can we do?
Originally, Ye Yu planned to kill the brothers Hou Wang and Hou Zhen and then throw them out from the mountain.
God is unaware of it.
But now, it can be seen clearly.
This is really hard to argue with.
The woman holding the sword saw that Ye Yu had not spoken.
Immediately he said in a deep voice: "I am Aoshu, the guard of Qingyun Sect's Law Enforcement Hall.
Now answer me, what is the exercise you just used? "
Ye Yu clenched his fists.
Still silent.
Because he really didn't know how to explain it.
Soul-catching.
It is definitely a magic sect technique.
He has nothing to do with the Qingyun Sect.
Moreover, even leaving aside the skills.
Killing an inner disciple is a capital offense.
After being encountered by the disciples of the Law Enforcement Hall, they can execute the law on the spot.
No matter what, it's a death.
Bastard, you just got the system and you just memorize it so little?
It would be nice if I could give myself a few more days to develop.
Ye Yu thought about it again and again.
Just when he was considering whether to fight to the death.
Wei Aoshu suddenly laughed.
Jump off the flying sword.
Came to Ye Yu.
He whispered: "Ten Thousand Souls Palace!"
Hear these three words.
Ye Yu suddenly opened his eyes wide.
How does this woman know about the Hall of Ten Thousand Souls?
Is it possible that the Hall of Ten Thousand Souls in the dream really exists here?
"What you just used was the Soul-Confining Technique in the Hall of Ten Thousand Souls, right?
I am also from the Hall of Ten Thousand Souls.
You are so lucky to have met me. "
Wei Aoshu raised his eyebrows slightly.
